## What's Changed
- chore: run Rust checks through mise before commits (fa14d95)
- Show merged delivery badges on Card worktree headers (9f8f8a1)
- docs(cli): guide agents to save the bundled Canban skill (d1ac1a3)
- feat: default agent RPC and CLI to concise responses (e7609e8)
- docs(insights): record rebased integration verification (8710644)
- feat(insights): add daily comparisons and annual contribution views (b4b520e)
- Document memory synchronization merge verification (c0470ad)
- Advance desktop API for merged state synchronization (1dfdd25)
- Document UI synchronization ownership and memory review contracts (f494f08)
- Record final native build and standard signpost acceptance (41ddb91)
- Reduce full-state memory churn and add Instruments profiling (02f7848)
- Simplify worktree-based Git workbench (#106) (6195870)
- Fix contextual Board and Git navigation and clear foreign Git selections (fcaee75)
- fix(ui): allow selecting and copying Card Markdown (b216537)
- Fix workflow column transition dispatch and event metadata (312e062)
- Make Card and Terminal branches open their changes directly (7cb6fa7)
- Unify Board filters and persist Mine per account and project (7059480)
- Open newly created Card details after submission (c8deed4)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jjyr/canban/compare/20261116-7...20261118-1

## What's Changed
- fix(git): scope refresh events and retain diff views (3e68835)
- perf(terminal): open new terminals before workspace refresh (c17019f)
- Improve Git workbench async loading and interaction feedback (f1b801d)
- fix(ui): acknowledge submissions before workspace refresh (b83a189)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jjyr/canban/compare/20261116-6...20261116-7

## What's Changed
- fix(test): capture pooled transport exit flag before replying (d2572f4)
- fix(github): coalesce cache refreshes by request start time instead of completion time (f53ea20)
- Adapt Codex launch environments through a shared provider boundary (a0b1805)
- fix(ui): show total running agents in Activity & Notifications instead of slot ratio (1d05f04)
- Simplify issue templates to Markdown and request Canban version (f11e864)
- feat(ui): separate non-project terminal directories and compact local home paths (2699576)
- Derive terminal navigation from live directories and retain sidebar rows (32e1ad4)
- Make GitHub settings responsive and queue project synchronization (b05d118)
- fix(ui-kit,ui): restore Menlo editor font cascade and guard CoreText caret measurement (4954ba9)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jjyr/canban/compare/20261116-5...20261116-6

## What's Changed
- docs: update multi-host Updating state, update.daemon, and DESKTOP_API 60 (f34f5ec)
- feat(hosts): surface live Updating status during remote daemon upgrades (19eb690)
- fix(app-server): fix TCP stream FD leak, update.daemon RPC timeout, and deleted exe resolution (c671d82)

## What's Changed
- fix(ui-kit,ui): eliminate uncomposited X11 GTK4 black boxes and theme Linux popups (4f78d20)

- fix(release): rename headless CLI archive to canban-cli-* to avoid GitHub asset case collision (788733c)
- fix(app-server): guard configuration session generations and in-flight outbox flushes (56b2b51)
- feat(website): update install tabs to Desktop/Headless, slogan, and CTA layout (c7f34dd)

## What's Changed
- feat(hosts): add remote daemon updates and unify UI routing under Hosts (e147449)
- feat(terminal): add Kitty Graphics Protocol rendering and default Ghostty identity (74ed4d0)
- feat(lifecycle): reclaim completed idle agent terminals after 30s (64afa3b)

- Refine agy Swarm and background-task status via Herdr screen inspection (0e6f221)

## What's Changed
- fix(ci): guard nullable Herdr observed/status fields in acceptance polling (0dee543)
- feat(ui): add Insights daily Kanban merge and Agent scheduling page (11a0f3b)
- feat(terminal): automatic Nerd Font fallback and cell scaling for PUA glyphs (cfdb3a9)

## What's Changed
- feat(updater,ci): add pre-upgrade SQLite snapshot rollback, release upgrade gate, and gh test isolation (3ebd9c6)

- refactor(context): replace inline prompt env overrides with $CANBAN_CLI (7e99d0c)

- feat(terminals): replace changed status with +N/-M diff line stats (2026c6c)
- feat(terminals): name shells from live per-project max, add Cmd+1..9, and refine close fallback (04f2fc4)

- fix(acceptance): update workflow schema check and card script log path (d5dcd6a)

- Replace project directory chooser with inline path combobox (#82) (1ee7a79)

- Update README (0b58abc)
- update README (ff16f6b)
- feat(website): redesign as Monokai CRT deck and enable GitHub Pages (912129d)
- fix(ui): track WorktreeScope selection in terminal tabs and highlight active tab (c591bff)

- docs: require English prompts and explicit user approval before prompt changes (fb29355)

- feat(terminals): show recognized Agent CLI icon in Shells from Herdr push (6a6c34f)

- feat(ui,ui-kit): rename Diff & Review to Git, add searchable ref/PR pickers, and streamline Git UI (81e2911)
- feat(agents): add collapsible Command + Argv editor in Settings (e585ef4)
- feat(website): add Zen static site for canban.dev with i18n and Pages deploy (3309ce4)
- Update README (c06e159)
- feat(ui): display reply icon and count on Board Cards when non-zero (f7dbeaa)
- ci(release): generate reverse-chronological non-merge commit changelog against previous release (2e8ecb6)
- feat(profiles,ui): detect per-model effort support and omit unsupported effort flags (29490e3)
- fix(ui): render plain Agents label in Board header without override count (9760f9c)
- docs(readme): streamline philosophy, highlights, installation, and drop local development (17924b6)
- feat(skill,review): prefer short card numbers in SKILL.md RPC examples and review.preview (323c868)
- refactor(terminals): show batch @merger directly under project root without special group (481269a)
- docs,install,terminal: add bilingual READMEs, curl installer, Monokai showcase, and fix initial zero-bounds PTY sizing (67c597d)
- feat(merge-queue): add batch merge queue, @merger session UI, and agy workspace trust (13ccbb5)
- feat(ids,storage): migrate instance IDs to 8-char hex and card paths to card numbers (62805b2)
- fix(workflow): route failed @merger retries through the FIFO merge queue (1bc73f0)
- feat(review): add Git client commit browser, staging, and remote sync (d48d739)
- perf(build,test): unify workspace features, cache ghostty-vt, avoid git env spawn, and use nextest (9f66883)
- feat(workflow): add schema 6 script steps, env propagation, and single-fallback recovery (c670547)
- feat(terminals): add worktree-scoped tabs, branch tree, and git status (33a98d9)
- fix(workspaces,workflow): preserve mid-rebase branch for @merger and allow retrying failed deliveries (8798b4e)
- feat(comments): support deleting own comments and jumping to GitHub comment anchors (ef40877)
- fix(ui): highlight Card Terminal icon directly instead of showing a badge dot (d746cf4)
- feat(ui,app-server): show compact elapsed runtime on Agent capsules and workflow stepper (a591cad)
- feat(comments): support editing own local and GitHub comments (8596276)
- fix(notifications): suppress false unreported-stop alerts until 1-hour idle fallback (3f6a51a)
- feat(ui,app-server): default Card Terminal split to collapsed, converge onto Terminal button, and inject CARD_ID (c31fac6)
- ci(release): publish official GitHub Releases and run integration tests before release (141940b)
- feat(agents): support per-project model and effort overrides for role identities (270b137)
- fix(startup): prevent theme remount loop and stabilize updater recovery (6c9d3c2)
- feat(delivery): default to rebase merge strategy and add squash/merge options (1501412)
- feat(startup): detect herdr-core on launch with Install and Check actions (e8d301e)
- fix(ui): re-enable YAML syntax highlighting in Workflow source editor (95688c3)
- fix(package,updater): refresh macOS bundle mtime and LaunchServices icon registration (7ba7b3a)
- refactor: remove Attempt and unify Card-role Agents onto TerminalEntry (8fd10e1)
- perf(terminal): eliminate open flash, add optimistic close, and pool sessions & RPC connections (2dd87b1)
- feat(ui): confirm before closing terminal with non-done running agent (d6db208)
- feat: remove Request model and unify Card CLI/terminal identity on CANBAN_CARD (5096236)
- feat(ui): render colored provider icons for Agent comment avatars (8939b6a)
- fix(ui): render full-height split divider in Card Live Terminal and Terminals (570225e)
- feat(board): display active column automation pills on column headers (606eee1)
- feat(ui,ui-kit): promote event-first hierarchy and semantic icon badges in Activity & Notifications (6337e16)
- build(release): require manual workflow_dispatch and add mise release task (d109224)
- feat(skill,ui): bundle Canban CLI skill, optional setup prompt, and global ⌘T terminal (41459a2)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jjyr/canban/compare/20261114-4...20261115-1
